claims.claim: 2026-10-23 GitHub announced that the Microsoft Teams GitHub app combines notifications and Copilot coding workflows.

Teams users can mention @GitHub in channels, group chats, or private chats to investigate an issue, fix a bug, run tests, or create a pull request; the linked issue/PR and conversation provide context.
The previous GitHub Notifications app can be updated; the legacy GitHub app is renamed GitHub (deprecated) and is scheduled for retirement on 2026-11-16.

GitHub’s Teams integration is in public preview, requires Teams app installation permission and GitHub account connection; the Teams client must have Microsoft Public Developer Preview enabled; Copilot cloud agent requires enabled cloud sandboxes and plan policy.

sources.title: Turn notifications into code with GitHub Copilot in Teams
sources.body: Oct 23, 2026. New GitHub app in Teams brings notifications and Copilot together. Users can get notifications in channels, group chats, or private chats and mention @GitHub to investigate issues, fix bugs, run tests, and create pull requests. Existing GitHub Notifications app can be updated. Legacy GitHub app is renamed GitHub (deprecated) and retired Nov 16. Connect account and select repository.

sources.title: Integrating GitHub with Teams
sources.body: GitHub integration in Teams supports notifications, GitHub actions, previews, and Copilot cloud agent sessions. Public preview. Prerequisites include GitHub account, Teams workspace and install permission, Microsoft Public Developer Preview enabled in the Teams client, and enabled cloud sandboxes for Copilot cloud agent.

sources.title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Slack and Microsoft Teams
sources.body: Sep 25, 2026. Public preview for organizations on Copilot Business and Enterprise; cloud agent policy and cloud sandboxes must be enabled. Usage counts against existing Copilot entitlements and can be governed by existing cloud-agent budgets. Capabilities may roll out gradually.

sources.title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
sources.body: Aug 21, 2026. Team members can collaborate in a Teams thread on a Copilot cloud agent session; users with write access can trigger repository changes. AI credits and sandbox usage are subject to billing and budgets. Additional approval can be required before a PR from the Teams integration identity merges.

cannotSay: Do not claim the integration is generally available; it is a public preview.
Do not imply every account can install it; Teams install rights, Copilot policies, and cloud sandboxes may be required.
Do not claim Copilot PRs merge automatically or that a test was actually run unless the article identifies a user-run verification step.
The announcement does not specify new standalone pricing; do not invent a fee or say it is included without qualification.
